localVerification.note: Post-documentation local checks are separate from the exact retained APKs used for device acceptance; device reports bind their original hashes and clean source commit.

scope: Official Bun 1.4.0 and locked supervisor in the v0.2.1 development arm64-only Debug APK, two complete 8-test Binder rounds on a Samsung Remote Test Lab physical device. Not acceptance of a published Release APK or every 16 KiB ABI/device.
testScope: Exact installed Bun payload and supervisor hashes; arm64-only package and PluginInfo ABI mapping
Action/category discovery, explicit service binding and Binder descriptor
Runtime version/revision, repeated prewarm and real JS/TS execution
Unicode stdout/stderr streaming and bounded terminal results
Five repository samples: JS, TS, file I/O, output and loopback fetch
Invalid/oversized requests, output limits, pre-dispatch and running cancellation
SIGTERM-ignoring cancellation after readiness (three per round), timeout and output limit; actual child absence and workspace deletion
Force-stop before each round followed by fresh instrumentation/Binder execution
